SELECT 
    ct.A3 as region,
    AVG(CAST(ct.district_count AS REAL)) as avg_district_count,
    AVG(CAST(ct.district_count AS REAL) / 4500.0) as avg_district_share
FROM (
    SELECT 
        a.district_id,
        d.A3,
        COUNT(*) as district_count
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3
) ct
GROUP BY ct.A3
ORDER BY ct.A3
